geometry_rules.volume: Exact region area times height; exact pL conversion before rounding
geometry_rules.membrane: Thin zero-excluded-volume interface with caller-declared positive constitutive path
geometry_rules.faces: Exact area-centroid link perpendicular to face, common projection strictly inside shared edge, correct side ownership; exact link and both side distances retained
geometry_rules.boundary: Each directed outer edge and both axial caps sealed; finite baths and one existing bath gauge

unsupported.rule: No generated/native source inference or previous whole-mesh acceptance
One explicitly segmented outer ring; exact area exhausts domain; no holes/gaps/overlap/T joins/unused vertices
Every cell side has a bath; direct cell-cell contacts/guessed clefts or cells on outer boundary refuse
Exact area centroids have a perpendicular link and strictly interior common projection; skew/midpoint or nonlocal substitutions refuse
Zero excluded volume thin interface, explicit positive path; no guessed compartment volume correction
All exterior sides and both axial caps explicitly sealed; actual finite baths; held reservoirs/outer fluxes refuse
Complete actual resolved_tissue@1 only; active/Ca/fuel/water/transport/intervention/event/epoch families require their separate future bridge
Static candidate; no trajectories, native equivalence, whole-mesh or prior pending polygon qualification inherited

independence.initial_field: Fresh process allows NumPy/SciPy, denies Cells/BETSE/JAX/Torch/Pillow; independent scalar transport and full-node charge/current equations, full derivative and physical field/rate comparisons
independence.actual_array_and_nonfinite_evidence: Typed NPZ arrays captured before JSON assertions; nonfinite binary64 bits retained; field returned before derivative construction saved independently

numerical_budgets.geometry: Exact correctly rounded binary64 target; no tolerance widening

field_comparison_scope.physical_outputs: Potentials, membrane and node capacitor charges, electrode/supply charge/current, membrane voltage rates, energies/powers, all transport fields and full state derivatives
